hints.title: Pascal Triangle XOR Reduction
hints.text: The xor score of a subarray obeys f[i][j] = f[i][j-1] ^ f[i+1][j], mirroring Pascal triangle addition over modulo two arithmetic.

hints.title: 2D Interval Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute all subsegment xor scores f[i][j] in O(n^2) by incrementing subarray length.

hints.title: Subarray Range Maximum
hints.text: Compute mx[i][j] = max(f[i][j], mx[i+1][j], mx[i][j-1]) to answer each query in constant time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputes full 2D lookup table in O(n^2) then answers each query in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating queries individually takes O(q * n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) memory enables instant O(1) query response.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes interval dynamic programming and range maximum reduction.
